name: Requesty usage
author: Cliffback
description: Enriches the built-in Omarchy Agents panel with a Requesty tab: pay-as-you-go spend, an optional monthly key-cap meter, and tokens by day and model from the Requesty management API. No widget, no UI of its own — the stock panel picks the tab up automatically.

install.notes: `omarchy plugin add https://github.com/Cliffback/omarchy-requesty-usage.git --enable`, then make sure the service is listed in shell.json: { "plugins": [ { "id": "cliffback.requesty" } ] }. The tab appears in your existing Agents panel as soon as a credential is resolved — nothing else to configure, and the panel itself is never modified or duplicated.

uninstall.notes: Removing the service stops the refreshes and unloads the tab from the Agents panel on the next rescan. The commands above are documentation; run them manually for a spotless cleanup.
